$comment: Every user-facing string, both targets (docs/PLAN.md rule 8). S0-03 owns the KEYS; Values written in S1-L0 (Claude, Voice Bank protocol, 2026-09-24). Every message is spoken, so key names are spelled out (Control Option V, Command C), never symbols. Web and Mac load this file; no string literal lives in UI code (scripts/strings-check.mjs). Every notice/error is also spoken (rule 8, 'Speak messages' default on). Placeholders {n} {mb} {words} {level} are filled at runtime.

$plan_wording.notice.all_cut: Couldn't make a summary I trust for this part.

$plan_wording.mac.intake.press_cmd_c: Press ⌘C to read it (spoken form: Press Command C to read it.)
$plan_wording.$comment: Wording the plan fixes (rules 2, 11, C3, C9, Architecture). S1-L0 keeps the meaning; it may tune words after the Voice Bank pass.
